title: Rubiginosin B selectively inhibits Treg cell differentiation and enhances anti-tumor immune responses by targeting calcineurin-NFAT signaling pathway.
authors: Geng, Chang-An; Chen, Feng-Yang; Zheng, Jing-Bin; Liao, Ping; Li, Tian-Ze; Zhang, Xue-Mei; Chen, Xin; Chen, Ji-Jun
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然产物Rubiginosin B通过靶向钙调磷酸酶-NFAT信号通路抑制Treg分化以增强抗肿瘤免疫，涉及分子对接但对象为蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The accumulation of CD4(+)Foxp3(+) regulatory T cells (Tregs) in the tumor microenvironment (TME) dampens anti-tumor immune responses and promotes tumor progression. Therefore, the elimination of Tregs has become a strategy to enhance the efficacy of tumor immunotherapy, although it is still a daunting challenge. Rhododendron brachypodum (R. brachypodum) is a perennial shrub mainly distributed in Southwestern China, whereas the chemical constituents in this plant remain elusive. PURPOSE: To identify small-molecule inhibitors of Tregs from R. brachypodum. METHODS: Meroterpenoids in R. brachypodum were isolated by column chromatography under the guidance of LCMS analyses. The structures of isolates were identified by spectroscopic data and quantum calculations. The activities of compounds were first evaluated on CD4(+) T cell differentiation by flow cytometry in Th1, Th2, Th17, and Treg polarizing conditions, and then on CT26 and MC38 murine colorectal carcinoma cells-allografted mice models. The mechanism of action was first investigated by determining Foxp3 degradation in Jurkat T cells transfected with pLVX-TetOne-Puro-Foxp3-tGFP, and then through analyses of Foxp3 expression on several pre-transcriptional signaling molecules. RESULTS: Two new prenylated phenolic acids (1 and 2) and a chromane meroterpenoid, rubiginosin B (RGB, 3) were obtained from R. brachypodum. The structure of S-anthopogochromene C (1) was rectified according to the electronic circular dichroism (ECD) experiment, and rhodobrachypodic acid (2) was proposed as the precursor of RGB by photochemical transformation. In this investigation, we first found that RGB (3) selectively suppressed the de novo differentiation of TGFbeta-induced CD4(+)Foxp3(+) regulatory T cells (iTregs), overcome the immunosuppressive TME, and consequently inhibited the growth of tumor in mouse models. The mechanistic study revealed that RGB could target calcineurin, inhibited the nuclear factor of activated T cells (NFAT) dephosphorylation, and down-regulated Foxp3 expression. The hypothetical binding modes of RGB with calcineurin were predicted by molecular docking, and the interactions were mainly hydrophobic effects and hydrogen bonds. CONCLUSION: These results suggest that RGB enhances anti-tumor immune responses by inhibiting Treg cell differentiation through calcineurin-NFAT signaling pathway, and therefore RGB or its analogs may be used as adjuvant agents meriting further investigation.
abstract_zh: 背景：肿瘤微环境（TME）中CD4(+)Foxp3(+)调节性T细胞（Tregs）的积累抑制抗肿瘤免疫反应并促进肿瘤进展。因此，消除Tregs已成为增强肿瘤免疫治疗疗效的策略，尽管这仍是一项艰巨的挑战。短柄杜鹃（R. brachypodum）是一种主要分布于中国西南地区的多年生灌木，但该植物中的化学成分仍不明确。目的：从短柄杜鹃中鉴定Tregs的小分子抑制剂。方法：在LCMS分析指导下，通过柱色谱法分离短柄杜鹃中的梅罗萜类化合物（meroterpenoids）。通过光谱数据和量子计算确定分离化合物的结构。首先在Th1、Th2、Th17和Treg极化条件下，通过流式细胞术评估化合物对CD4(+) T细胞分化的活性，然后在CT26和MC26小鼠结直肠癌同种异体移植瘤模型中进行评估。作用机制首先通过检测转染pLVX-TetOne-Puro-Foxp3-tGFP的Jurkat T细胞中Foxp3降解来研究，随后分析Foxp3在多个转录前信号分子上的表达。结果：从短柄杜鹃中获得两种新的异戊烯基酚酸（1和2）以及一种色烷梅罗萜类化合物rubiginosin B（RGB，3）。根据电子圆二色谱（ECD）实验修正了S-anthopogochromene C（1）的结构，并推测rhodobrachypodic acid（2）通过光化学转化为RGB的前体。在本研究中，我们首次发现RGB（3）选择性抑制TGFbeta诱导的CD4(+)Foxp3(+)调节性T细胞（iTregs）的从头分化，克服免疫抑制性TME，并因此抑制小鼠模型中的肿瘤生长。机制研究表明，RGB可靶向钙调磷酸酶（calcineurin），抑制活化T细胞核因子（NFAT）去磷酸化，并下调Foxp3表达。通过分子对接预测了RGB与钙调磷酸酶的假设结合模式，相互作用主要为疏水效应和氢键。结论：这些结果表明，RGB通过钙调磷酸酶-NFAT信号通路抑制Treg细胞分化来增强抗肿瘤免疫反应，因此RGB或其类似物可能作为辅助剂，值得进一步研究。
